title: What is voice cloning?

body.text: creates an AI voice from a real voice sample. Record a short clip of yourself and you get 'your voice' that can say anything you type — great for making content in your own voice without re-recording every time. Quality depends on how clear the sample is.

example: Record yourself reading an article for 1–2 minutes in a quiet room → use it as the reference to clone your own voice

title: Always get permission

body.text: Never clone someone else's voice without permission
— it violates both ethics and the terms of use. Only clone your own voice, or a voice whose owner has consented in writing. Impersonating someone's voice can be illegal and cause serious harm.

example: To use a team host's voice → get written consent before recording the voice sample

options.text: Creates an AI voice from a real voice sample

question: What does cloning quality depend on?

options.text: How clear the reference voice sample is

question: What's the proper way to clone a voice?
